responsibility: This definition module specifies the gm2 buffered file I/O subsystem. It defines the abstract File handle type, standard streams, and the public operations for opening and closing files, checking status, buffered and direct byte I/O, character and string I/O, binary CARDINAL serialization, unread support, position control, filename queries, and flushing, serving as the principal runtime file abstraction above raw Unix file descriptors and beneath wrappers such as IO and SFIO.
same_name_distinction: This is the public API/specification for the buffered file subsystem, defining the abstract File handle, exported operations, and standard stream variables, while leaving buffer structures, descriptor tables, and Unix call integration to FIO.mod.
